title: Nettle & Bone
author: T. Kingfisher
summary: The youngest princess of a minor kingdom sees her sister suffer in a brutal royal marriage and decides the only fix is to remove the prince. Her quest gathers an unlikely band of helpers, including a witch and a retired knight.
readIf: you like fairy tales with a dry sense of humour, practical heroines and a bunch of oddballs who become a team.
skipIf: you would rather avoid a story that begins with an abusive marriage, even though it is handled with care.

pairings.reason: Also a clever, grounded fairy-tale retelling where hard-working women outwit powerful and dangerous men.
Shares the warm, wry humour and the ramshackle household of misfits, in a gentler and more playful story.
